name: GUILD-on-the-Web
story: GUILD-on-the-Web was an environmental spatial-data service released by Landcare Research in January 1996. Robert Gibb led its development and David Medyckyj-Scott was a co-developer. It provided public web access to environmental information and was described in their 1996 Spatial Information Research Centre paper.

Medyckyj-Scott recalls GUILD as a conceptual predecessor to later Landcare portals and to Digimap, which he led at the University of Edinburgh. Claims that GUILD was the first operational public environmental-data web service are attributed to the developers. Its documented release places it among the early applications in New Zealand web GIS.

sources.label: D-Lib Magazine, David Medyckyj-Scott author biography, May 2004: GUILD released January 1996
David Medyckyj-Scott and Andrew Cowie, Web Mapping and Scientific Data: The Experiences of Landcare Research, GeoCart 2016
